lyrics:
[Intro: bass line alone, finger snaps, a soft kick]

[Verse 1: whispered, close, deadpan]
Bare feet
Cold tea
Reading your texts upside down
Sweet me
Lets you
Think you run this town
I nod, I smile, I pass the salt
If something breaks it's not my fault

[Pre-Chorus: kick doubles, voice a little louder]
So you're the hero, you're the lead
You've got the jawline and the speed

[Chorus: half spoken, then a spoken punchline]
You think you're the main event
The big reveal, the hundred per cent
Saved the day and got the kiss
Cute.
I'm the plot twist

[Synth Hook: cartoonish wobbling synth melody, bass and claps]

[Verse 2: whispered, more amused]
I like
It when
You take control of the remote
I let
You pick
I let you rock the boat
I let you think you won the race
I moved the finish line last year

[Pre-Chorus: kick doubles, voice a little louder]
So you're the hero, you're the lead
You've got the jawline and the speed

[Chorus: half spoken, then a spoken punchline]
You think you're the main event
The big reveal, the hundred per cent
Saved the day and got the kiss
Cute.
I'm the plot twist

[Synth Hook: cartoonish wobbling synth melody, bass and claps]

[Beat Switch: tempo drops, slow dark trap beat, low sub-bass]
I'm the twist
I'm the twist
You didn't see me coming
Did you?

[Outro: slow beat, whispered, one finger snap]
Obviously
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 135 BPM, 4/4, G minor, switching to a slow half-speed beat for the last section. Sly, bouncy and close to the ear.

VOICE: Female, sung in a soft whisper right against the microphone, with almost no projection. Deadpan and amused. The chorus is half spoken. The punchline words are spoken flat, with no music under them. Layered whispers and breathy harmonies in the background.

INSTRUMENTS: A plucked, rubbery electric bass playing the main riff. Finger snaps. A soft, punchy kick drum. Handclaps. A cartoonish, wobbling synth lead that plays the hook where a chorus would be. Deep sub-bass and slow, heavy hi-hats after the switch. Small household clicks and taps as percussion.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the bass line with snaps. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:36 Pre-chorus. 0:43 Chorus 1, ending on the spoken punchline in silence. 0:57 Synth hook. 1:11 Verse 2. 1:33 Pre-chorus. 1:40 Chorus 2. 1:54 Synth hook. 2:22 Beat switch: the tempo halves and a dark, slow beat with heavy sub-bass takes over. 2:55 Outro, a whisper and a single snap at 3:05.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s bedroom pop: extremely dry and close, huge sub-bass, almost no reverb, silences used as punctuation.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The one-word spoken punchline at about 0:54, with everything else cut out.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a teenager's taunt. This is somebody who has been quietly managing a household, an office or a marriage for decades and is amused that nobody noticed.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Mock meekness, amusement, the reveal, a dark little victory lap.
